en.headline: Cross-boundary operator proposes lower Huanggang senior fares
en.dek: Eternal East Bus wants elderly and disabled fares on its Huanggang routes cut toward franchised-bus levels, and hopes to join the two-dollar scheme.
body: A cross-boundary coach operator plans to cut fares for elderly and disabled passengers on routes serving the redeveloped Huanggang Port, and hopes to be brought into the government's two-dollar concession scheme, Now News reported.

Choi Shun-kei, deputy general manager of Eternal East Bus, said the company runs two 24-hour express services between Huanggang and Tsim Sha Tsui, and between Huanggang and Kwun Tong. On the Tsim Sha Tsui route, the weekday elderly fare is more than 30 dollars; the company hopes to bring it down to the teens, closer to a franchised bus fare, so it can compete once franchised buses serve the new port.

Choi said weekday waits on the Tsim Sha Tsui service are about half an hour, and that evening and night departures would be tightened to every 10 to 15 minutes after the port opens. He also said the company expects a jump in passengers and wants a larger quota of imported drivers.

The Transport Department told Now News that cross-boundary fares are set by operators under the market, and that any concession is a commercial decision. It said it would stay in contact with the trade so services remain stable around the opening. Choi said the department had taken the company's views, but that the two-dollar scheme sits with the Labour and Welfare Bureau.

zh.headline: 跨境巴士擬減皇崗長者車費
zh.dek: 永東直巴希望把來往皇崗的長者及殘疾人士車費減至與專營巴士相若，並爭取納入兩元乘車優惠。
body: 有跨境巴士營辦商打算在新皇崗口岸開通後，下調長者及殘疾人士車費，並希望納入政府兩元乘車優惠計劃。Now新聞周四報道有關安排。
永東直巴副總經理蔡順基說，公司營運兩條二十四小時跨境快線，分別來往皇崗與尖沙咀、皇崗與觀塘。以尖沙咀線為例，平日長者車費三十多元，公司希望日後減至十多元，與專營巴士相若，以免口岸有專營巴士後客源流失。
他說，尖沙咀線平日約半小時一班，口岸開通後黃昏及晚上會加密至十至十五分鐘一班。他又預計客量會大增，希望當局增加外勞司機配額。
運輸署向Now新聞表示，跨境巴士票價由營辦商按市場機制自行制定，是否提供優惠屬商業決定，署方會與業界保持聯繫，確保口岸開通前後服務穩定。蔡順基說，向運輸署反映時意見獲接納，但兩元優惠的政策局是勞工及福利局，仍須繼續爭取。
